vectors.name: Genuine identity and supported API
vectors.acceptance: Existing seven runtime/four type names and AuthenticatedRepo shape unchanged; genuine extraction registered only by existing issuer; clone/parsed/prototype/fake handle refuses; no public registrar.

vectors.name: Standalone presence and absence
vectors.acceptance: Use existing genuine P256/secp256k1 fixtures and same checked walker; fresh empty offline cache authenticates CAR and reproduces every requested found CID/raw bytes or absence.

vectors.name: Exact root and output order
vectors.acceptance: Header selects original issuer root only; selected commit included once; deduplicate actual visited nodes and found records by canonical CID; sort CID lexically, repeated call same evidence -> byte-identical CAR.

vectors.name: Encountered versus final stack
vectors.acceptance: Exercise retreat/absence branch traversal; include every encountered node used by P1 checks, not just final stack; maintained proof helper is an inclusion/exclusion test oracle, not another verifier.

vectors.name: No global canonicality upgrade
vectors.acceptance: Unseen malformed branch does not become validated; encountered faults still reject; no whole-tree/complete replay/current identity claim from sparse CAR.

vectors.name: Owned snapshots
vectors.acceptance: Mutate original request objects/list after first await and output CAR after return; original operation target is captured and cache/capability/repeated proof stay unchanged.

vectors.name: Selected commit eviction
vectors.acceptance: Evict original root from shared cache while lookup node/record survives; extraction unavailable, not authority re-created from metadata or an uncharged retained commit.

vectors.name: Missing after prior success
vectors.acceptance: Missing/evicted node or record after online success makes whole extraction unavailable; no partial proof or automatic root/key/intent retarget.

vectors.name: Expected CID and input precedence
vectors.acceptance: Same input error for expected CID mismatch; invalid path/canonical CID/row fields/signal shape before stricter local resource policy; preserve original compressed-key and low-S semantics.

vectors.name: Exact row and input-byte bounds
vectors.acceptance: Zero paths allowed only commit diagnostic; exactly bounded count/UTF8 tuple framing; duplicate rows charged before node dedup; over count/input16MiB refused before unbounded capture.

vectors.name: Exact portable output bounds
vectors.acceptance: Header+CID+entry varint framing counts in 16MiB serialized output; selected commit counts in <=50000 unique blocks; stricter issuer car/block bounds still win; host128MiB does not expand export.

vectors.name: Structural versus collection overflow
vectors.acceptance: Collector retains no overflow bytes; completes only current bounded checked walk so already exposed interval faults outrank missing/limit; valid complete overflow is native_proof_limit; no next path or partial CAR.

vectors.name: Missing during overflowing walk
vectors.acceptance: Missing proof stays content_unavailable after existing structural cleanup; overflow marker cannot downgrade known invalidity or produce partial CAR.

vectors.name: Cancellation and runtime identity
vectors.acceptance: Aborted signal between paths/writer chunks withholds output; no forced decode interruption claim; foreign failures retain exact error identity.

vectors.name: Original capability and no new owner
vectors.acceptance: Warm fill updates only existing shared cache; old genuine object remains identity used by prefix/observer and extractor; no caller-supplied map, nodes, closures, descriptor/reader callback or trust flag.

vectors.name: Claim-complete scope
vectors.acceptance: Required receipt paths all offline-verifiable; missing participant/source/content closure prevents complete-replay labels; oversized requested audit never silently becomes suffix-only evidence.

vectors.name: Actual runtime/build gates
vectors.acceptance: Node22/24/26 source and actual emitted production plus actual Chromium; unchanged P1 corpus and source/build/installed closure pins; new API not executed in this source packet.

vectors.name: Budget instrumentation
vectors.acceptance: Measure actual node/record/hash/key/signature/serialization work where observable; unavailable instrumentation is null/unknown, not zero; memory copies and collector overhead reported.

vectors.name: Shared selected parser
vectors.acceptance: Module-only selection and old constructor use existing read/selected-root validation; exactly one selected header root and hash-verified present commit DATA; P1 alone authenticates DID/key/root.

vectors.name: Exact-set before admission
vectors.acceptance: Shared exact-set predicate rejects extra/omitted/invalid hash/truncated response before any cache mutation; never admit a valid-looking subset.

vectors.name: Physical duplicates
vectors.acceptance: 65 physical duplicate blocks exceed response cap before CID dedup; duplicates at or below64 preserve existing set semantics; all requested unique CIDs still present.

vectors.name: Header roots are not authority
vectors.acceptance: Zero/multiple/foreign response header roots stay bounded syntax only; helper output selects retained root; changed actual selected commit root restarts rather than mixes proofs.

vectors.name: Owned selected commit and mutation
vectors.acceptance: Capture selected root/bytes, request array and raw response before awaits; mutated input cannot change serializer; forged selected DATA must fail hash or subsequent fixed-binding P1 authentication.

vectors.name: Bounded small output
vectors.acceptance: At most64 response unique blocks plus retained commit, dedup if already included; exact framed16MiB output cap and each1MiB block, current input32MiB/header16KiB/depth64 caps.

vectors.name: Atomic admission and prior cache
vectors.acceptance: Use genuine authenticateRepo prototype dispatch with same cache/root/DID/key/limits; malformed/oversized/bad signature batch admits none and evicts no prior blocks.

vectors.name: Identity retained
vectors.acceptance: Ignore new same-root capability after checked fill and retain original genuine object; its new lookups see admitted bytes; root/key/DID change never retargets it.

vectors.name: No retained-map work
vectors.acceptance: Fill CAR contains only commit+new response blocks; record actual bounded parsing/hash/writer work, no entire retained map sort/copy/recompose/rehash on each fill.

vectors.name: Repeated verification is explicit
vectors.acceptance: Intake hashes and P1 supplied-block hashes repeat, commit/key/low-S signature checks repeat; no skip-verify API or cached key-currentness assertion.

vectors.name: Observer gates still owed
vectors.acceptance: One30s/64req/32MiB I1 reservation across retries, active checks around local units; existing16 subject-path cap unchanged; full shared registry/cursor and PD2 handoff remain separate.

vectors.name: P4/PD1 separation
vectors.acceptance: Fill/export creates no prefix/floor/receipt/cursor or P4 coverage; preserve current owner and unpublished floor checks, independent registry recheck, asserted-origin/deferred-coverage refusal and no encoded capability restore. Current approved PD1 poison/pendingFault refusal conservatively withholds the shared account cursor for all registered apps; any floor-fact-only recovery alternative needs a separate reviewed private seam/test decision before caller implementation.
